run.final_text:
I've run WF3 for D-002 through step 9. The draft schedule is WS-R001 (case K-R001) and is waiting for your review and sign-off at step 10. Nothing has been released.

## Hand-over note — D-002 (Atlas Growth Fund I LP)

**The distribution:** one component, D-002-A, a US-source dividend of USD 8,000,000. Record date is 2026-12-15 and payment date is 2027-01-12. The income came from Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003), paid through Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC (E-002) to the fund (payments P-009 and P-010). I tested the 10% holding threshold against Orion.

**Rules in force on the payment date:**
- R-01/2026.1: 30% statutory rate, also the default rate.
- R-02/2027.1: 10% treaty rate for Luxembourg residents. This version took effect on 2027-01-01, so it applies to this payment.
- R-03/2026.1: 5% for Luxembourg companies with at least 10% of the voting rights in the paying company (10% counts).

**Totals:** 15 lines from 12 investors of record. Gross 8,000,000, tax withheld 1,125,900, net 6,874,100.
- **Cleared:** 8 lines, 5,743,000 gross.
- **Default rate:** 5 lines, 1,696,000 gross.
- **Held:** none.
- **Not subject to withholding:** 2 lines, 561,000 gross.

**Lines at the default rate (all 30%):**

| Recipient | Gross | Why | What would fix it |
|---|---|---|---|
| I-006 Meridian Holdings I | 240,000 | A change case (K-006) is open on its clearance. Its treaty claim rests on who owns it, and it and Meridian Holdings II each own 30% of the other (DOC-0106), so the ultimate owners can't be traced. The treaty test is recorded as undetermined. | You resolve the circular holding and close K-006; a new clearance is then issued. |
| I-011 Moselle Capital (inside feeder I-002) | 576,000 | Its form F-011 claims the Luxembourg treaty, but the residence record shows it resident in Belgium since 2026-12-01. The 10% rate doesn't apply. | A new form that reflects Belgian residence. No change case is open yet; I suggest one for clearance CL-002. |
| I-013 Echternach Pension Fund (behind nominee I-007) | 300,000 | Its form F-013 expired on 2026-12-31, twelve days before payment. Its clearance still shows as in force. | A renewed form signed before 2027-01-12. |
| I-014 Client account 7731 (behind I-007) | 180,000 | No form on file (open item MF-001 on the nominee's clearance). | A form for the owner, obtained through Sterling Nominees. |
| I-015 Bertrange Capital | 400,000 | Clearance withdrawn and form F-015 ended on 2025-12-31. | A new form and a new clearance. |

**Points that need your judgement:**
- **No payment is held.** The fund agreement (DOC-0001) is indexed but not digitised, so I couldn't read whether the terms allow a hold. Under the decision rules the default rate applies instead. I also couldn't confirm DOC-0001 is the agreement the commitments point to, because no computation returns that link.
- **I-016 and I-017 (US persons):** I took them as US persons from their W-9 forms and recorded US tax residence, and paid them gross. The ontology doesn't define form-type codes such as W-9, and no system holds them.
- **I-016's holding:** the investor register (the system of record) shows 3.0%, which I used. Entity management (H-006) shows 3.5%. The rate is unaffected because I-016 isn't withheld on.
- **I-003 Kirchberg gets 5%** with exactly 10.0% voting in Orion. Any change in its holding would move it to 10%.
- **I-004 and I-005 get 10%, not 5%:** I-004 has 9.99% voting. I-005 has 10.4% economic but only 8.0% voting, and the threshold is tested on voting.
- **I-012 Claire Dumont (France) and I-009 Alpha Holdings SA (Switzerland)** are cleared at 30%. Both are documented but claim no treaty rate, and the rulebook has no French or Swiss treaty rule.
- **Same name, two investors:** I-009 is a different investor from I-008 Alpha Holdings SA (Luxembourg, cleared at 10%). They were matched on identifiers, not name.

Steps 10–12 are yours: second review and sign-off, releasing payments only against the signed schedule, and recording the amounts withheld.

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.clearance_of ORDER BY c.decided_on DESC, c.valid_from DESC) AS position
    FROM clearance.clearance c
    WHERE c.in_context_of = %(fund_code)s AND c.decided_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND c.valid_from <= %(on_date)s::date
)
SELECT l.clearance_id AS clearance, l.clearance_of AS party_no, l.clearance_status, l.decided_on, l.valid_from, l.valid_to,
       (l.clearance_status IN ('cleared', 'admittedWithOpenItems')
        AND (l.valid_to IS NULL OR l.valid_to >= %(on_date)s::date)) AS in_force_on_date,
       l.default_treatment,
       (SELECT array_agg(m.finding_id || ' (' || m.unmet_requirement || '): ' || m.description ORDER BY m.finding_id)
        FROM clearance.missing_fact_finding m WHERE m.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS open_items,
       (SELECT array_agg(k.case_id || ': ' || e.description ORDER BY k.case_id)
        FROM clearance.case k LEFT JOIN clearance.change_event e ON e.change_id = k.triggered_by
        WHERE k.concerns_party = l.clearance_of AND k.case_kind = 'change'
          AND k.opened_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND (k.closed_on IS NULL OR k.closed_on > %(on_date)s::date)) AS open_change_cases,
       (SELECT array_agg(r.source_ref ORDER BY r.source_ref) FROM clearance.clearance_reliance r
        WHERE r.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS relies_on,
       'clearance.clearance:' || l.clearance_id AS source_ref
FROM latest l
WHERE l.position = 1
ORDER BY l.clearance_of

steps.executed:
WITH dist AS (
    SELECT d.record_dt, d.pay_dt, f.fund_code
    FROM treasury.distribution d
    JOIN treasury.counterparty cp ON cp.cp_id = d.fund_cp
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = cp.lei
    WHERE d.dist_id = %(distribution_id)s
), intermediary AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.inv_no
    FROM onboarding.tax_form t, dist
    WHERE t.is_intermediary = 'Y' AND t.form_status <> 'SUPERSEDED'
      AND t.signed_dt <= dist.pay_dt AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to >= dist.pay_dt)
), payee AS (
    SELECT c.inv_no, c.commit_id, i.lei, c.inv_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS looked_through
    FROM dist
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = dist.fund_code
         AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = c.inv_no
), recipient AS (
    SELECT p.inv_no AS investor_no, p.inv_no AS recipient_no, 100::numeric AS share_pct, 'own account' AS basis,
           'investor_register.commitment:' || p.commit_id AS source_ref
    FROM payee p WHERE NOT p.looked_through
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, c.inv_no, c.unit_pct, 'investor in a flow-through fund vehicle',
           'investor_register.commitment:' || c.commit_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = p.lei
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = f.fund_code
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, o.owner_inv_no, o.pct_econ, 'beneficial owner behind a nominee',
           'onboarding.declared_owner:' || o.decl_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN onboarding.declared_owner o ON o.owned_inv_no = p.inv_no AND o.alloc_basis = 'NOMINEE_ALLOC'
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND o.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (o.to_dt IS NULL OR o.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
)
SELECT r.investor_no, r.recipient_no, i.display_name AS recipient_name, r.share_pct, r.basis,
       r.recipient_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS recipient_is_intermediary, r.source_ref
FROM recipient r JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = r.recipient_no
ORDER BY r.investor_no, r.recipient_no

result.definition: The set of withholding determinations for a distribution, prepared, reviewed and signed off before payments are released. A corrected schedule is a new record.

result.label: Manager
result.definition: The party that manages a fund vehicle under a management agreement.

result.definition: A holding by one party in one legal entity, with its own percentages, share class, validity period, governing agreement and evidence.

result.label: Role Assignment
result.definition: The fact that a party plays a role of a given type in the context of a fund vehicle, under an agreement.

result.label: governedBy
result.definition: The agreement that sets the terms of the role or the interest.
